Correct a record

A claim needs a change.

Include its stable ID, the original source version and locator, the proposed wording, and the reason. Source and review dates are preserved when a correction is accepted.

Submit a correction →

Review a section

Put a conclusion to the test.

Name the report release and chapter. Check the source support, alternatives, missing evidence, and practical implications. State relevant interests and whether scoped public credit is permitted.

Contribute a review →

Share a reuse

Show the work it supports.

Link a public artifact and explain which release, data, or methods you used. A visit, download, or repository star is an activity measure, not evidence of adoption.

Report a public reuse →

What review means here

New evidence requires separate author, source-verifier, and adversarial AI review invocations. An automated review is labeled as AI review. It does not imply human expert review or external endorsement.

External contributions are voluntary. Public credit requires consent and states the actual edition, section, and contribution. We do not infer affiliation or employer endorsement from a contribution. No external review is claimed without an actual receipt.

External participation is not a release requirement. The same evidence, coverage, and quality requirements apply to every record.
